prerequisites: All those that provide technical knowledge and sectoral competences.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the professional reality of the mechanical industrial sector.
Acquire professional experience to confidently approach integration into the labor market.
Integrate acquired theoretical and practical knowledge by applying it to a real context.
Collect data, interpret it, and produce technical reports.
Verify the importance of group work within the company.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the professional tasks of the Mechanical Engineer
Integration of acquired knowledge into a business environment
Acquisition of experience in professional practice and knowledge about company operations
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on the external tutor's report (60%, not recoverable), the student's report (30%), and the academic tutor's monitoring (10%). Failure to meet attendance limits, unexcused absence, not completing the training project, or not submitting the report on time will result in a 'FAIL' grade, truncated to a maximum of 4.5 points.
